data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- Closes plan-review F5 gap: an OVER_BOUND PR carries no DSO-Story-Merge trailer and would otherwise fail verify-session-provenance.sh's check. Without this task, the first OVER_BOUND PR will fail the integration-review provenance gate.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh`:

1. Add a new acknowledged-non-provenanced exit code path: exit code 3 (or similar; verify against the existing 0/1/2 contract from epic spec).
2. For each commit being verified, check whether the commit's body contains the marker `DSO-Review-Coverage:` (visibility trailer namespace) AND the ledger entry for that commit shows status=OVER_BOUND.
3. If OVER_BOUND detected: emit a clear log line 'commit <sha> status=OVER_BOUND; acknowledged non-provenanced (large-diff routed to FP-recovery)'. Exit code 3 (NOT 1, which means unprovenanced-runs-LLM).
4. Update tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh to include this case.

The S1 contract for verify-session-provenance.sh exit codes:
- 0: provenanced (skip LLM dispatch)
- 1: unprovenanced (run LLM dispatch — full-diff fallback)
- 2: budget-exhausted (run LLM dispatch — full-diff fallback)
- 3 (NEW): OVER_BOUND (acknowledged non-provenanced — DO NOT run LLM dispatch; route to admin/FP-recovery)

Coordinate with ci.yml:llm-review's exit-code handler: a 0-or-3 result skips LLM; 1-or-2 runs LLM.

Update S1's contract test (in S1.T5 or sibling) to assert the new exit-3 path.

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_verify_session_provenance_over_bound]`.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh` | modify | tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh | needs-modification |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (llm-review job's exit-code handling) | modify | tests/workflows/test-ci-llm-review-exit-codes.sh | needs-modification |
| `tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh` | modify | (this IS the test) | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] verify-session-provenance.sh has exit-code 3 path
  Verify: grep -qE 'exit 3|EXIT_OVER_BOUND' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] verify-session-provenance.sh detects DSO-Review-Coverage marker
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO-Review-Coverage' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] Test asserts exit 3 for OVER_BOUND fixture
  Verify: grep -qE 'OVER_BOUND.*exit 3|exit 3.*OVER_BOUND' tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] ci.yml's llm-review exit-code handler treats 3 same as 0 (skip LLM)
  Verify: grep -qE 'exit_code.*0.*3|3.*acknowledged' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_verify_session_provenance_over_bound\]' \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.

## Note on cross-story coordination
This task touches verify-session-provenance.sh which S1.T5 also modifies (extending grep to accept DSO-Story: AND DSO-Story-Merge:). S7.T11 must rebase against S1.T5's changes; both modifications are additive (different regex/exit-code branches) so they should not conflict, but careful merge is required.
data.title: S7.T11: Extend verify-session-provenance.sh to recognize OVER_BOUND as acknowledged-non-provenanced path
